verdict: Fixture replacement preparation blocked the intended workload; not evidence of general host incapacity.
cost_evidence: Current source takes separate per-object locks, validates old rows, reads them again for extra-field checks, traverses reverse/generic relations, and constructs a native deletion Collector per object. At interruption it was materializing a field-update QuerySet for the deletion ownership check. This confirms the active stage, not the fraction of 840 seconds spent in each substage.
historical_context: September 24 first creation took 817.678 seconds under the same 840-second soft limit, on a different 3518-object profile. It is risk evidence, not a timing estimate for the 7016-object agreed profile.

decision: Stop expanding fixtures and controller machinery. Review a focused model/relation-batched replacement implementation preserving native validation, signals, ownership refusal and atomic rollback; reuse current correctness regressions.
